witnesses.strategy: Choose the success disjunct. Unfold entry/index scan invariants; use byte range, byte <> 255 and byte_eq_255_of_low_bits to establish offset < 8. Then id/8=index and id mod 8=offset. The land-zero exit guard gives original byte testbit offset=false; query_eq proves id is free. For any smaller nonnegative id, its byte precedes index (use index invariant and Ztestbit_255_low) or its offset precedes the scan offset (use entry invariant), establishing minimality. Normalize both unsigned_last_nbits operands using byte range and 0 <= id mod 8 < 8. Instantiate the store_id_map existential with the actual replace_Znth array. Prove id_map_bytes_ok for id::old_ids: preserve length, bounded bytes and old-id range; freeness gives NoDup; use Znth replacement and lor/shiftl testbit equations, distinguishing the updated index and bit from all other bits. The selected bit becomes true and all other queried bits remain unchanged, matching id_in_ids_add_neq. Fold store_idmanager_allocated_unlinked with the unchanged old bucket invariant. Convert quot to div by nonnegative idmax+7 and recombine OSHeap through crtos_heap_lift_sep/definitions; manager fields and bucket heap cancel. No new helper declarations: keep intermediate assertions inside this witness.
